paragraphs.text: 1. YE, Waters, are beneficent: so help ye us to energy
paragraphs.original: आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवस्ता न ऊर्जे दधातन ।
paragraphs.translit: āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvastā na ūrje dadhātana |

paragraphs.text: That we may look on great delight.
2. Give us a portion of the sap, the most auspicious that ye have,
paragraphs.original: यो वः शिवतमो रसस्तस्य भाजयतेह नः ।
paragraphs.translit: yo vaḥ śivatamo rasastasya bhājayateha naḥ |

paragraphs.text: Like mothers in their longing love.
3. To you we gladly come for him to whose abode ye send us on;
paragraphs.original: तस्मा अरं गमाम वो यस्य क्षयाय जिन्वथ ।
paragraphs.translit: tasmā araṃ gamāma vo yasya kṣayāya jinvatha |

paragraphs.text: And, Waters, give us procreant strength.
4. The Waters. be to us for drink, Goddesses for our aid and bliss:
paragraphs.original: शं नो देवीरभिष्टय आपो भवन्तु पीतये ।
paragraphs.translit: śaṃ no devīrabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye |

paragraphs.text: Let them stream to us health and strength.
5. 1 beg the Floods to give us balm, these Queens who rule o'er precious things,
And have supreme control of men.
6. Within the Waters-Soma thus hath told me-dwell all balms that heal,
And Agni, he who blesseth all.
7. O Waters, teem with medicine to keep my body safe from harm,
paragraphs.original: आपः पृणीत भेषजं वरूथं तन्वे मम ।
paragraphs.translit: āpaḥ pṛṇīta bheṣajaṃ varūthaṃ tanve mama |

paragraphs.text: So that I long may see the Sun.
8. Whatever sin is found in me, whatever evil I have wrought,
paragraphs.original: इदमापः प्र वहत यत्किं च दुरितं मयि ।
paragraphs.translit: idamāpaḥ pra vahata yatkiṃ ca duritaṃ mayi |

paragraphs.text: If I have lied or falsely sworn, Waters, remove it far from me.
9. The Waters I this day have sought, and to their moisture have we come:
O Agni, rich in milk, come thou, and with thy splendour cover me.
paragraphs.original: पयस्वानग्न आ गहि तं मा सं सृज वर्चसा
paragraphs.translit: payasvānagna ā gahi taṃ mā saṃ sṛja varcasā
